description: Compact rows with a one-click order button and a phone field.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Quick order in one click: compact rows (name, weight, summary, price) each with an order button named after
  the dish, under a phone field that the one click uses. Axes: phone (show, hide), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type QuickOrderProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  phone?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Input from "../compose/Input.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import Field from "../components/field.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  phone = "show",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<QuickOrderProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="zap" :title="empty" />
    <Stack v-else gap="4" align="stretch" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl">
      <Field v-if="((phone as string) === 'show')" :label="labels.phone" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-phone', id)">
        <Input type="tel" :name="tpl('{0}-phone', id)" :id="tpl('{0}-phone', id)" />
      </Field>
      <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col" data-testid="items">
        <ListItem
          v-for="d in dishes"
          :key="d.id"
          class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 border-b border-border py-4"
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <Group gap="2" align="baseline">
              <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                {{ d.name }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ d.weight }}
              </Text>
            </Group>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ d.summary }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Inline class="text-base font-bold">
            {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
          </Inline>
          <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button" :aria-label="tpl(labels.orderOf, d.name)" data-testid="order">
            <LucideIcon name="zap" :size="16" />
            {{ labels.order }}
          </Button>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
